Also bookmarked "forge neural" (the curated-neural-network idea) in persistent memory for a future dedicated session -- deliberately not built tonight, explained why in the attached record.

Live run status (RUN_20260806_1917, SLS(113)): still stable, still 0 active positions, $794.23 balance, 0% drawdown, 0% exposure. It reached Phase 6 and ARMED earlier on just 1 OOS trade -- fragile, watching closely. No real trade has opened yet, only the standard harmless Phase-0 self-test probes. SLS(114) (tonight's newest build) is NOT yet attached -- current live run is untouched by anything shipped after it started.
